scope: Root-authored legacy execution-controls adapter and its corrected binding. A separate section records the archive checker implemented by this reviewer; it is not represented as self-independent review.

execution_controls_assessment.conclusion: Only worker-rollout-regression/concurrency-correctness/cache-fill-invalidation receives the frozen adapter. It derives service.mjs-only editing and node verify.mjs from the unchanged original case requirements, preserves raw case/prompt/rubric/fixture identity, and applies no retrospective controls to older freezes. The run-derived edit list, verifier argv, and derivation now must equal the frozen controls.

closed_findings.reproduction: Prepare the cache regression, append project/verify.mjs to run.json editable_files and set verification_argv to null, leaving control and freeze untouched. Before the fix loadControlledCase returned the case and runTrial(execute:false) returned dry_run. The mutable verifier field could also skip independent verification.
closed_findings.resolution: Compare all three run-derived execution fields to the exact frozen execution controls before dispatch, scoring input preparation, and verification. Tests independently alter each field and reject through loadControlledCase and dry dispatch.
closed_findings.independent_recheck: Child reviewer also replayed each mutation through loading, dry dispatch and verifyTrial; all reject. Valid metadata is accepted, and old-style freezes preserve empty editable files, null verifier, and not_required verification.

archive_checker_implementation.declaration: Base archive-manifest.json may declare complete_source_trees as a unique array drawn from candidate, original-project, final-project, trial, candidate-dependencies. Supplements may provide expected files but may not declare completeness.
archive_checker_implementation.behavior: Every available source inventory binds published original hashes. Declared-complete trees require exact path sets in the validated manifest union and on disk. Single-skill candidate, fixture, before and after inventories bind aggregate digests and corresponding workspace subsets. Native originals bind prepared.baseline; final project/dependencies bind run.final_files. Only .agents/, .codex/, and .tal-skills/ count as installed native dependencies. Undeclared old archives may remain partial.
archive_checker_implementation.independent_review_issue: An initial leading-dot partition would misclassify project dotfiles and reject old partial original-project/.gitignore. Corrected to explicit installed-directory prefixes and full baseline lookup for undeclared originals; complete and partial dot-project cases are tested.
archive_checker_implementation.acceptance_separation: A dependency mutation honestly recorded in final inventory and published bytes remains archivable; archive integrity does not grade behavioral success.

independent_review_closure.method: Read-only final source inspection; separate from author-run tests.

executed_checks.scope: Local synthetic runner, archive, filesystem and verifier tests; no models.
Published evidence integrity only; experiments not rerun or graded.

executed_checks.detail: validateFreeze accepted regression03; candidate and corpus dictionaries match regression02 exactly.
git diff --exit-code HEAD is empty for distributed-correctness/cases.json and cache-fill-invalidation fixtures.
git diff --check passes for the four scoped code/test files; all six prior review artifacts retain exact hashes.

limits: Native skill behavior, model adherence, actual cache correctness, and production runtime behavior were not evaluated by these checks.
The archive checker verifies declared evidence consistency and source completeness; it does not grade responses, authenticate an external trusted signer, or infer that a failed attempt passed.
Undeclared older archives intentionally retain partial-publication semantics. Complete declarations must be supplied by the archive exporter.
Earlier candidate reviews remain historical records; this supplement identifies current runner/checker bytes and does not rewrite earlier results.
